meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先做调试取证和复现,判断缺陷属于哪个仓库,再生成一篇英文 GitHub issue,包含环境、复现步骤、根因和修复建议;只有针对 openai/codex 时才可能提 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分流 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发,尤其在你需要源码佐证的根因和 GitHub 归属判断时。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 安装失败的问题提个 issue
say.note: 它会先复现并确定目标仓库

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 崩溃能定位根因并提到 openai/codex 吗
say.note: 上游 bug 可能会直接提 PR

say.text: 先查查这个 bug 是不是已经有人提过,有就补评论

howto.what_en: After install, Claude investigates and reproduces the bug, routes it to the repo that owns it, then files an English GitHub issue with environment, repro steps, root cause, and fix guidance; a PR only for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when you need source-backed root cause and GitHub routing.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex issue for my failed install
say_en.note: It reproduces first, then picks the repo

say_en.text: Can you confirm this Codex CLI crash's root cause and file it upstream?
say_en.note: Upstream bugs may get a PR

say_en.text: Check if this bug is already reported and comment if so
